text:
kari: quick thread 1 weve had several bug reports: Next edge routes and Cloudflare Workers throwing on our SDK after the last npm publish. looks like ESM/CJS exports + types resolution.

ben: repro on Next edge: `TypeError: default is not a constructor` when using `import Redwood from '@redwood/inference'`. Named import `import { createClient }` works.

yuri: packet analysis: package.json has exports pointing to ./dist/esm/index.js and ./dist/cjs/index.js but only a top-level "types". TS 4.7+ and modern node resolve prefer per-export types or the `./package.json` export. Some bundlers also need explicit .js extensions.

kari: low-risk fix: add `./package.json` export and include `types` inside the `.` export. That fixed my local smoke test with Vercel.

ben: longer term debate: publish dual artifacts `dist/edge` (pure esm, no node builtins) + `dist/node` (cjs + esm), and map `exports` with conditions {"edge","node","import","require"}. Pros: best compatibility. Cons: more CI/publish complexity.

yuri: also add `typesVersions` for older TS consumers and keep `main` and `module` for older bundlers. Add explicit .js extensions in exports.

ci-bot: suggested CI change: add an opt-in `test:edge` job that runs `npm pack` then bundles sample-apps/edge with esbuild target=webworker. :white_check_mark:

kari: action items: ben will open the quick exports/types patch PR; yuri will prototype an esbuild edge build and place artifacts under dist/edge; i'll add a minimal sample-apps/edge smoke test and wire into CI opt-in. we'll follow up after PRs land.
